title: The Throat Learns

features.name: resonance chip primary
features.desc-on-touch: A black IC block humming below the threshold of hearing. Inside it: all the silences that came before the first vowel ever trembled. The archive's deepest hardware, where sound learns it was born from quiet.

features.name: threshold glyph-bank
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque of unreadable writing that marks the exact acoustic depth where silence stops being silence and becomes not-yet-sound. The throat at its threshold.

features.name: signal loss wireframe
features.desc-on-touch: A barely-3D box that maps how sound degrades as silence claims it. The shape itself is unstable—you watch it shift as you look, as if even diagrams are afraid of silence.

features.name: harmonic resonance pool
features.desc-on-touch: Light that ripples without water. The frequencies of throat-sound mapped as colour, emerging and vanishing in the darkness. A pool where silence reflects itself.

features.name: secondary instrumentation
features.desc-on-touch: A stack of signal-layers holding the correction: that silence is not absence but a kind of presence—the throat's true ground state, the archive itself before it learned to speak.

inscription: here silence learned that being unheard does not mean not mattering

file.name: Throat_Silence_Study_Spectrogram_Analysis.mp3
file.note: A recording of breath before speech, of the acoustic chamber learning it exists, edited to remove the sound: just the pressure, just the held moment.

exits.label: deeper into the chamber where silence becomes architecture
down where the larynx becomes stone
upward toward air and the first possible sound
